newsitem.title: FRANCE: Car sales in France fell 30.7 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Car sales in France fell 30.7 pct in June.

text.p: New car sales in France were down 30.7 percent in June, at 93,212 units, from year-earlier levels, the French carmakers committee CCFA said on Tuesday.
On a like-for-like basis the decline was 34 percent, the CCFA said.
For the first six months of 1997, car sales in France were down 23.7 percent at 784,559 units, it said in a statement.
Car sales at Renault, which experienced labour problems at some of its dealership network, fell 48.1 percent to 18,465 units for a market share of 19.8 percent.
Sales of PSA Peugeot Citroen cars fell 21.1 percent to 33,715 units for a market share of 36.2 percent in June.
French car makers took 56 percent of the domestic market in June and had 54.9 percent for the six-month period.
